lines.text: Six a.m. The alarm screams. And the very first thought? Nope. Not today.
You don't want to get up. You don't want to go to work. Not again!
Bills. Emails. Meetings. Every single day, the exact same thing!
And you ask yourself: What is all of this even for?
Ten thousand years ago, people had real problems. Hunger. Cold. Predators.
They would have given anything for a warm bed.
And out there? Planets circling, where nobody feels anything. Ever.
But you? You get to be angry! You get to be happy! You get to laugh with friends until it hurts!
So maybe it's okay not to feel like it today.
Just get up. One day at a time.
